entities.summary: Gisele Barreto Fetterman is a Brazilian-born American activist and nonprofit executive. She is a founder of the non-profit Freestore 15104 and a co-founder of the non-profits For Good PGH and 412 Food Rescue. She is married to U.S. Senator John Fetterman of Pennsylvania. She was active in public life as the Second Lady of Pennsylvania during her husband's tenure as lieutenant governor.
